text: In Adelaide, the exhausted widow Amelia raises six-year-old Sam alone, [still unable to face the car crash|wrong|loss that won't heal] that killed her husband as he drove her to give birth. One night Sam asks her to read [a pop-up book called Mister Babadook|images|books, letters and writing], whose top-hatted figure grows more menacing with every page. She tears it up, but it returns to the doorstep reassembled, with new pages showing her killing the dog, her son and herself, and soon the thing from the book is [working its way into her|threat|being taken over].
